test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
'A + B' means 'A is the son of B'.

 

'A - B' means 'A is the mother of B'.

 

'A × B' means 'A is the father of B'.

 

'A ÷ B' means 'A is sister of B'.

 

If J ÷ K × L + M – N, then which of the following statements is not correct?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Son
 Mother
 Father
 Sister
 
 

 

Given: J ÷ K × L + M - N

It means: J is the sister of K, K is the father of L, L is the son of M, M is the mother of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdddbb97bb94f43649087e362a0b63bdc35cdcaf5837566a1dfcbcf0594fa8b5.png] 

Option 1) K is father of N - True

Option 2) K is Husband of M - True

**Option 3) J is mother of L **- **False **(Because,, J is the aunt of L)

Option 4) L is Brother of N - True

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
